pipeline.code:
// KGM 중간완료_20단계_2026-06-30-11-13-01
// Step 1: E열 '안전제일' 필터링 (망개통용 제외) 및 새 시트로 복사
// Created: 2026-06-30T02:13:01.016Z
// KGM 안전제일_올인원 완료_16단계_2026-06-26-11-21-39
// Step 1: E열 '안전제일' 필터링 (망개통용 제외) 및 새 시트로 복사
// Created: 2026-06-26T02:21:39.084Z
Sub B2BSkill()
    Dim wbSrc As Workbook, wsSrc As Worksheet, wsNew As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    Dim dataRng As Range, visibleRng As Range
    Dim hdrRow As Long
    Dim prevCalc As XlCalculation
    
    prevCalc = Application.Calculation
    On Error GoTo Cleanup
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    
    ' 대상 워크북 및 시트 참조
    Set wbSrc = Workbooks("원본_DSMC_260624.xlsx")
    Set wsSrc = wbSrc.Worksheets("202605_SS001643_ENTR_BY_STACC_P")
    
    hdrRow = 1
    lastRow = wsSrc.Cells(wsSrc.Rows.Count, "E").End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < hdrRow Then lastRow = hdrRow
    
    lastCol = wsSrc.Cells(hdrRow, wsSrc.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    
    ' 새 시트 생성
    Set wsNew = wbSrc.Worksheets.Add(After:=wbSrc.Worksheets(wbSrc.Worksheets.Count))
    wsNew.Name = "안전제일_필터결과"
    
    ' 헤더 복사
    wsSrc.Range(wsSrc.Cells(hdrRow, 1), wsSrc.Cells(hdrRow, lastCol)).Copy Destination:=wsNew.Cells(hdrRow, 1)
    
    ' 데이터 범위 설정
    Set dataRng = wsSrc.Range(wsSrc.Cells(hdrRow, 1), wsSrc.Cells(lastRow, lastCol))
    
    ' AutoFilter: E열(5열)에 "안전제일" 포함, "망개통용" 제외
    dataRng.AutoFilter Field:=5, Criteria1:="*안전제일*", Operator:=xlAnd, Criteria2:="<>*망개통용*"
    
    ' 필터된 행 복사 (헤더 제외)
    On Error GoTo NoVisibleRows
    Set visibleRng = dataRng.Resize(dataRng.Rows.Count - 1, dataRng.Columns.Count).Offset(1, 0).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible)
NoVisibleRows:
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Set visibleRng = Nothing
    End If
    
    If Not visibleRng Is Nothing Then
        visibleRng.Copy Destination:=wsNew.Cells(2, 1)
    End If
    
    ' AutoFilter 해제
    wsSrc.AutoFilterMode = False
    
Cleanup:
    Application.Calculation = prevCalc
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Raise Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description
    End If
End Sub

# KGM 안전제일_올인원 완료_16단계_2026-06-26-11-21-39
# Step 2: 안전제일_필터결과 시트에서 T열, M열, N열 순으로 오름차순 정렬합니다.
# Created: 2026-06-26T02:21:39.084Z
def transform(ctx):
    sheet = "안전제일_필터결과"
    last_row = ctx.last_row(sheet)
    last_col = ctx.last_col(sheet)
    
    def col_to_letter(n):
        result = ""
        while n > 0:
            n, remainder = divmod(n - 1, 26)
            result = chr(65 + remainder) + result
        return result
    
    range_str = f"A1:{col_to_letter(last_col)}{last_row}"
    
    ctx.sort(sheet, range_str, key_col=["T", "M", "N"], ascending=[True, True, True], has_header=True)

Sub B2BSkill()
    Dim prevCalc As XlCalculation
    prevCalc = Application.Calculation
    On Error GoTo Cleanup
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim w As Workbook
    Dim sh As Worksheet
    Dim destWsName As String
    destWsName = "안전제일중복제거값"
    
    ' 대상 워크북 찾기
    Set wb = Nothing
    For Each w In Application.Workbooks
        If w.Name = "원본_DSMC_260624.xlsx" Then
            Set wb = w
            Exit For
        End If
    Next w
    If wb Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "'원본_DSMC_260624.xlsx' 파일을 찾을 수 없습니다."

    ' 대상 시트 찾기
    Set ws = Nothing
    For Each sh In wb.Worksheets
        If sh.Name = "안전제일_필터결과" Then
            Set ws = sh
            Exit For
        End If
    Next sh
    If ws Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "'안전제일_필터결과' 시트를 찾을 수 없습니다."

    ' 기존 결과 시트 삭제 (있다면) - On Error Resume Next 없이 For Each로 확인
    For Each sh In wb.Worksheets
        If sh.Name = destWsName Then
            sh.Delete
            Exit For
        End If
    Next sh

    ' 필터링 및 복사
    ' V열은 22열. 행 전체 데이터를 보존하기 위해 A:V 범위를 필터링 대상으로 함.
    Dim filterRange As Range
    Set filterRange = ws.Range("A1:V147711")
    
    With filterRange
        .AutoFilter Field:=22, Criteria1:="1"
        
        ' 새 시트 생성
        Dim destWs As Worksheet
        Set destWs = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))
        destWs.Name = destWsName
        
        ' 필터링된 데이터 복사 (AutoFilter 상태일 때 Copy는 가시 셀만 복사)
        .Copy Destination:=destWs.Range("A1")
    End With
    
    ' 필터 해제
    ws.AutoFilterMode = False

Cleanup:
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.Calculation = prevCalc
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Raise Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description
    End If
End Sub

Sub B2BSkill()
    Dim prevCalc As XlCalculation
    prevCalc = Application.Calculation
    On Error GoTo Cleanup
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim wsSrc As Worksheet
    Dim wsDst As Worksheet
    Dim w As Workbook
    Dim sh As Worksheet
    
    ' 대상 워크북 찾기
    Set wb = Nothing
    For Each w In Application.Workbooks
        If w.Name = "원본_DSMC_260624.xlsx" Then
            Set wb = w
            Exit For
        End If
    Next w
    If wb Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "'원본_DSMC_260624.xlsx' 파일을 찾을 수 없습니다."

    ' 소스 시트 찾기
    Set wsSrc = Nothing
    For Each sh In wb.Worksheets
        If sh.Name = "안전제일_필터결과" Then
            Set wsSrc = sh
            Exit For
        End If
    Next sh
    If wsSrc Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "'안전제일_필터결과' 시트를 찾을 수 없습니다."

    ' 대상 시트 찾기
    Set wsDst = Nothing
    For Each sh In wb.Worksheets
        If sh.Name = "안전제일중복제거값" Then
            Set wsDst = sh
            Exit For
        End If
    Next sh
    If wsDst Is Nothing Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "'안전제일중복제거값' 시트를 찾을 수 없습니다."

    ' 소스 시트 데이터 범위 확인 (A열 기준 마지막 행)
    Dim lastRowSrc As Long
    lastRowSrc = wsSrc.Cells(wsSrc.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRowSrc < 2 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "소스 시트에 데이터가 없습니다."

    ' 보조 열 사용 (Z열, 26열) - 조건 체크용
    Dim auxCol As Long
    auxCol = 26 ' Z열
    
    ' 기존 AutoFilter 해제
    If wsSrc.AutoFilterMode Then wsSrc.AutoFilterMode = False

    ' 보조 열에 조건식 작성
    ' V열(22)이 2,3,4 중 하나이고 W열(23)이 FALSE(0)인 경우 TRUE, 아니면 FALSE
    Dim formulaRng As Range
    Set formulaRng = wsSrc.Range("Z2:Z" & lastRowSrc)
    formulaRng.Formula = "=IF(AND(OR(V2=2,V2=3,V2=4),W2=FALSE),TRUE,FALSE)"
    
    ' 보조 열 기준으로 필터링
    Dim filterRange As Range
    Set filterRange = wsSrc.Range("A1:Z" & lastRowSrc)
    filterRange.AutoFilter Field:=auxCol, Criteria1:="TRUE"
    
    ' 필터링된 가시 셀만 복사
    Dim visibleRange As Range
    Dim dataBody As Range
    Set dataBody = wsSrc.Range(wsSrc.Cells(2, 1), wsSrc.Cells(lastRowSrc, auxCol))
    
    On Error Resume Next
    Set visibleRange = dataBody.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible)
    On Error GoTo Cleanup
    
    If Not visibleRange Is Nothing Then
        ' 대상 시트 M142403 아래 첫 빈 행 찾기
        Dim pasteRow As Long
        pasteRow = 142403 + 1
        
        ' 붙여넣기 (A열부터 시작)
        visibleRange.Copy Destination:=wsDst.Cells(pasteRow, 1)
    Else
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 514, "B2BSkill", "조건에 맞는 행이 없습니다."
    End If
    
    ' 필터 해제 및 보조 열 삭제
    wsSrc.AutoFilterMode = False
    wsSrc.Columns(auxCol).ClearContents

Cleanup:
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.Calculation = prevCalc
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Raise Err.Number, Err.Source, Err.Description
    End If
End Sub

    ' 데이터 범위 확인 (E열 기준 마지막 행, 1행 기준 마지막 열)
    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long

    If lastRow < 1 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "데이터가 없습니다."

    ' 필터 범위 설정

    If ws.AutoFilterMode Then ws.AutoFilterMode = False
    
    ' AutoFilter 적용: E열(5열)에 '올인원' 포함

    Set newWs = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))

    ' 헤더 복사

Sub B2BSkill()
    Dim prevCalc As XlCalculation: prevCalc = Application.Calculation
    Dim raisedNum As Long, raisedSrc As String, raisedDesc As String
    On Error GoTo Cleanup
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    
    Dim wbDst As Workbook, wsDst As Worksheet
    Dim wbSrc As Workbook, wsSrc As Worksheet
    
    ' 대상 워크북/시트 참조
    Set wbDst = Workbooks("원본_DSMC_260624.xlsx")
    Set wsDst = wbDst.Worksheets("202605_SS001643_ENTR_BY_STACC_P")
    
    ' 소스 워크북/시트 참조
    Set wbSrc = Workbooks("교체된 CCU 목록(2026-02-12).xlsx")
    Set wsSrc = wbSrc.Worksheets("교체된 CCU 목록")
    
    ' 1. 삭제 조건값 (EID) 로드 (D3:D1914)
    Dim dict As Object
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Dim srcRng As Range
    Set srcRng = wsSrc.Range("D3:D1914")
    Dim srcArr As Variant
    srcArr = srcRng.Value
    
    Dim i As Long
    Dim key As String
    For i = 1 To UBound(srcArr, 1)
        If Not IsEmpty(srcArr(i, 1)) Then
            key = Trim(CStr(srcArr(i, 1)))
            If Len(key) > 0 Then
                If Not dict.Exists(key) Then
                    dict.Add key, True
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    If dict.Count = 0 Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "삭제 조건값(EID)이 없습니다."
    End If
    
    ' 2. 대상 시트 T열 (20열) 데이터 확인 및 마킹
    Dim tCol As Long: tCol = 20 ' T열
    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = wsDst.Cells(wsDst.Rows.Count, tCol).End(xlUp).Row
    
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "대상 데이터가 없습니다."
    End If
    
    ' 보조열 위치
    Dim lastCol As Long
    lastCol = wsDst.Cells(1, wsDst.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    Dim auxCol As Long: auxCol = lastCol + 1
    
    ' T열 데이터 읽기 (2행 ~ lastRow)
    Dim dstRng As Range
    Set dstRng = wsDst.Range(wsDst.Cells(2, tCol), wsDst.Cells(lastRow, tCol))
    Dim dstArr As Variant
    dstArr = dstRng.Value
    
    ' 마킹 배열 생성
    Dim markArr() As Variant
    ReDim markArr(1 To UBound(dstArr, 1), 1 To 1)
    Dim r As Long
    Dim val As String
    Dim matchCount As Long: matchCount = 0
    
    For r = 1 To UBound(dstArr, 1)
        If Not IsEmpty(dstArr(r, 1)) Then
            val = Trim(CStr(dstArr(r, 1)))
            If Len(val) > 0 And dict.Exists(val) Then
                markArr(r, 1) = "B2B_DELETE"
                matchCount = matchCount + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next r
    
    If matchCount = 0 Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 514, "B2BSkill", "일치하는 행이 없습니다."
    End If
    
    ' 보조열에 마크 쓰기
    Dim auxRng As Range
    Set auxRng = wsDst.Range(wsDst.Cells(2, auxCol), wsDst.Cells(lastRow, auxCol))
    auxRng.Value = markArr
    
    ' 3. 필터링 및 삭제
    Dim filterRng As Range
    Set filterRng = wsDst.Range(wsDst.Cells(1, 1), wsDst.Cells(lastRow, auxCol))
    
    filterRng.AutoFilter Field:=auxCol, Criteria1:="B2B_DELETE"
    
    ' 보이는 셀 확인 후 삭제
    Dim visData As Range
    ' matchCount > 0 이므로 보이는 셀이 반드시 존재합니다.
    Set visData = filterRng.Resize(filterRng.Rows.Count - 1).Offset(1, 0).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible)
    
    visData.EntireRow.Delete
    
    ' 정리
    wsDst.AutoFilterMode = False
    wsDst.Columns(auxCol).Delete
    
Cleanup:
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.Calculation = prevCalc
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        raisedNum = Err.Number
        raisedSrc = Err.Source
        raisedDesc = Err.Description
    End If
    
    If raisedNum <> 0 Then
        Err.Raise raisedNum, raisedSrc, raisedDesc
    End If
End Sub

    If lastRow <= hdrRow Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "데이터가 없습니다."
    lastCol = ws.Cells(hdrRow, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    
    Dim auxCol As Long: auxCol = lastCol + 1
    
    ' E열 데이터 배열 읽기 (헤더 제외)
    Dim eArr As Variant
    eArr = ws.Range(ws.Cells(hdrRow + 1, eCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, eCol)).Value

    Dim auxArr() As Variant
    ReDim auxArr(1 To UBound(eArr, 1), 1 To 1)
    
    Dim r As Long
    Dim targetVals As Variant
    targetVals = Array("안전제일", "인포콘 올인원", "인포콘 올인원 2.0")

    If Err.Number <> 0 Then

Sub B2BSkill()
    Dim prevCalc As XlCalculation: prevCalc = Application.Calculation

    Set wb = Workbooks("원본_DSMC_260624.xlsx")

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 5).End(xlUp).Row ' E열 기준
    
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "데이터가 없습니다."

    Dim lastCol As Long
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim eArr As Variant
    Dim eRng As Range
    Set eRng = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 5), ws.Cells(lastRow, 5))
    eArr = eRng.Value
    
    Dim markArr() As Variant
    ReDim markArr(1 To UBound(eArr, 1), 1 To 1)
    
    Dim r As Long
    Dim hasDelete As Boolean: hasDelete = False

        If Trim(CStr(eArr(r, 1))) <> "인포콘 올인원" Then

            hasDelete = True

    Dim filterRng As Range

        If wsLoop.Name = sheetName Then Set ws = wsLoop: foundWs = True: Exit For
    Next wsLoop
    If Not foundWs Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "시트 " & sheetName & "을 찾지 못했습니다."

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, 5).End(xlUp).Row ' E열 기준
    
    If lastRow < 2 Then Err.Raise vbObjectError + 513, "B2BSkill", "데이터가 없습니다."

    ' E(5) ~ N(14) 열 읽기 (10열)
    Dim dataArr As Variant
    Dim srcRng As Range
    Set srcRng = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 5), ws.Cells(lastRow, 14))
    dataArr = srcRng.Value
    
    Dim dict As Object
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    Dim r As Long
    Dim key As String
    Dim eVal As Variant, mVal As Variant, nVal As Variant
    
    ' 배열은 1-based. 
    ' Col 5(E) -> Index 1 (MVNO상품명)
    ' Col 13(M) -> Index 9 (수납금액)
    ' Col 14(N) -> Index 10 (가입자당단가_도매대가)
    For r = 1 To UBound(dataArr, 1)
        eVal = dataArr(r, 1) 
        mVal = dataArr(r, 9) 
        nVal = dataArr(r, 10) 
        
        ' 키 생성: 구분자로 Chr(1) 사용
        key = CStr(eVal) & Chr(1) & CStr(mVal) & Chr(1) & CStr(nVal)
        
        If dict.Exists(key) Then
            dict(key) = dict(key) + 1
        Else
            dict.Add key, 1
        End If
    Next r
    
    ' 결과 시트 준비 (중복 시 삭제)
    Dim shCheck As Worksheet
    For Each shCheck In wb.Worksheets
        If shCheck.Name = "피벗_결과" Then
            Application.DisplayAlerts = False
            shCheck.Delete
            Application.DisplayAlerts = True
            Exit For
        End If
    Next shCheck
    
    Dim wsOut As Worksheet
    Set wsOut = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
    wsOut.Name = "피벗_결과"
    
    ' 식별자 열 서식 지정 (규칙 준수)
    wsOut.Columns(1).NumberFormat = "@"
    
    wsOut.Cells(1, 1).Value = "MVNO상품명"
    wsOut.Cells(1, 2).Value = "수납금액"
    wsOut.Cells(1, 3).Value = "가입자당단가_도매대가"
    wsOut.Cells(1, 4).Value = "개수"
    
    Dim outArr() As Variant
    ReDim outArr(1 To dict.Count, 1 To 4)
    Dim i As Long
    Dim parts As Variant
    Dim keyItem As Variant
    
    i = 1
    For Each keyItem In dict.Keys
        parts = Split(keyItem, Chr(1))
        outArr(i, 1) = parts(0)
        ' 숫자 변환 시도
        If IsNumeric(parts(1)) Then outArr(i, 2) = CDbl(parts(1)) Else outArr(i, 2) = parts(1)
        If IsNumeric(parts(2)) Then outArr(i, 3) = CDbl(parts(2)) Else outArr(i, 3) = parts(2)
        outArr(i, 4) = dict(keyItem)
        i = i + 1
    Next keyItem
    
    If dict.Count > 0 Then
        wsOut.Range(wsOut.Cells(2, 1), wsOut.Cells(dict.Count + 1, 4)).Value = outArr
    End If

Cleanup:
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        raisedNum = Err.Number: raisedSrc = Err.Source: raisedDesc = Err.Description
    End If
    Application.Calculation = prevCalc
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    If raisedNum <> 0 Then Err.Raise raisedNum, raisedSrc, raisedDesc
End Sub
